example: The team responded with alacrity to the chance to test its idea.
nuance: Alacrity often describes willingness to act; speed without willingness is insufficient.
prompt: A volunteer eagerly accepts an unexpected assignment.
options: She accepted the assignment with alacrity and immediately offered to help further.
He accepted with alacrity only after repeated pressure, visibly reluctant.
The work showed alacrity because every measurement was exact.
reasons: This sentence demonstrates the meaning: cheerful readiness or eagerness.
Exactness is precision, not cheerful readiness.
